Gesundheit und Medizin: - Unhealthy oceans can lead to human diseases through contaminated seafood and cause economic losses due to the collapse of shellfish populations.  
- Human health issues, such as medications for diabetes, can harm marine life by persisting in ocean environments.  
- Solutions include early warning systems for shellfish diseases and selective breeding to maintain healthy stocks and sustainable practices.

Gaming: **Dennis Schröder Joins Sacramento Kings**

Dennis Schröder has joined the Sacramento Kings basketball team. He will play as their main point guard, which is like the team's leader on the court. The Kings are happy to have him because he is a great player and they believe he can help them win more games.

Technologie und Innovation: Brazilian farmers are increasingly turning to biological fertilizers to reduce their reliance on imported chemical fertilizers. This shift gained momentum during the pandemic and Russia's war in Ukraine, which caused fertilizer shortages. Biological fertilizers, which are more affordable and environmentally friendly, have become a popular alternative for many farmers.

Sport Deutschland: Die neue Bundesregierung betont die Bedeutung des Frauensports als wachsendes Marktsegment, das anerkannt werden muss. Im deutschen Frauennbasketball feiern die Spielerinnen Erfolge wie den Olympia-Sieg im 3x3 und Platz fünf bei der EM, doch schlechte Bezahlung und mangelnde Infrastruktur treiben Topspielerinnen ins Ausland. Global steigt der Umsatz im Frauensport, mit einem großen Anteil aus den USA, wo der Frauen-Basketball boomt.
